about: Entry aerodynamics of sphere-cone forebodies. Built by our table builder (not included).
method: SU2 8.5.0 Euler (axisymmetric at alpha 0 for Mach 2 to 20 and gamma 1.10 to 1.40; 3-D half-body at alpha 5 to 22 deg, Mach 20 and Mach 3, gamma 1.30) on the 70 deg reference forebodies (nose radius / base radius 0.5 and 1.0). Hypersonic values scaled to the real gas's effective gamma (Mutation++ equilibrium shocks) by the stagnation pressure ratio. Other half-angles and nose radii: modified Newtonian times the CFD-to-Newtonian ratio of the reference shapes. Below Mach 2 the hand fit's Mach shape (data.CAPSULE_CD_MACH) is kept.
conventions: Reference area pi D^2/4, length D. CA positive aft. Table alpha is positive; flight alpha may be negative: CA is even, CN and Cm odd. With MSL's sign, alpha -16 gives CN < 0 and lift > 0. Cm about the nose apex, Cm = -CN x_cp / D.
forebody_only: No backshell or base pressure: Euler forebody to the shoulder plus a short straight afterbody.
